args.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production cosmic game scenery, matching supplied reference palette, luminous chalk pastel/gouache medium, soft paper tooth and atmospheric negative space. Generate 3 COMPLETE TALL PORTRAIT PAINTINGS SIDE BY SIDE, equally sized, exactly3 columns×1row; each panel aspect390:844. No gaps, borders, text, labels, UI or circles. Combined aspect 1170:844. Every panel must be completely separate at its exact column boundary.
Each panel places its distinctive cosmic vista only in the UPPER QUARTER, smoothly fading below into an exceptionally quiet pale bone/bluegray painted work area covering at least lower70%. Keep lower70% very low contrast, no identifiable objects or star points there. The source reference's pale lower area and calm bluegreen, mutedplum, amber palette set the standard. The game overlays circular objects and dark line-drawn fixed receivers around40%height, so keep those positions pale and empty. No earthly horizon, tables, paper frame, panels within panels or diagram arrows.
Exact left-to-right scenes:
PANEL 1: Upper quarter: a vast crooked fork of opaque plum interstellar dust, close enough to see denser cloud folds, several weak inflowing ribbons. All gas, absolutely no bright stars or central disk. Keep the main fork cropped at top/left so it reads as extensive environment rather than a second isolated inventory cloud.
PANEL 2: Upper quarter: open fan of numerous distant, separately luminous modest stars nested within broad remaining dark gas, not a compact triangular cluster. No jet, pillars, cleared cavity or bright glowing fringe yet. This is a broad nursery environment; do not copy any complete circular icon or include a separate close-up disk.
PANEL 3: Upper quarter: a recognizable old spiral at far upperleft, its outer arm pulled into one broad hooked tidal tail arcing toward upperright, tenuous plum dark gas interleaved with widely spread modest stars. A diffuse nursery glow stays far inside the old arm, no resolved new tail cluster, no shell, no cold-knot target painted separately. Keep the hook recognizable across repeated views.
Physical constraints: stars are separated compactpoints, gas is broadvolume; noneofthese are explosions of galaxies. Do not add iconic blackholes, glowingtori, jets or planets for decoration. Never show a future result that the scene forbids. Every scene shares one gentle atmospheric finish and visual scale appropriate to its stated context. No photographic lensflare or text.
